cardEffects:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Play 1 [Amon of Crimson Flame] Token (Digimon/Red/6000 DP/＜Rush＞) and 1 [Umon of Blue Thunder] Token. (Digimon/Yellow/6000 DP/＜Blocker＞)
[All Turns] When this Digimon would digivolve or leave the battle area, delete all of your [Amon of Crimson Flame]s and [Umon of Blue Thunder]s. If you deleted a Digimon with this effect, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
name: Goldramon

rulings.answer: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays tokens that are treated as Digimon named [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.
rulings.question: What's a token?

rulings.answer: No, they can't. The [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder] tokens played by this card's effect can't become targets for effects with requirements related to play cost or level because these tokens don't have a play cost or level.
rulings.question: Can [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder] tokens played by this card's effect become targets for "Digimon with play costs of X or less" effects or "level X or higher/lower Digimon" effects?

rulings.answer: Yes, it can. Even if you have only 1 [Amon of Crimson Flame] or [Umon of Blue Thunder] token, it will be deleted and <Recovery +1 (Deck)> will activate.
rulings.question: Can this card's [All Turns] effect activate <Recovery +1 (Deck)> and delete my [Amon of Crimson Flame] or [Umon of Blue Thunder] when I only have one or the other?

rulings.answer: No, it only activates once. No matter how many [Amon of Crimson Flame] and/or [Umon of Blue Thunder] you delete at one time with this effect, <Recovery +1 (Deck)> will only activate once.
rulings.question: If this card's [All Turns] effect deletes 2 of my [Amon of Crimson Flame] and/or [Umon of Blue Thunder], does <Recovery +1 (Deck)> activate twice?

rulings.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
